_doc: Canonical ids. Spoken names in scenes are surnames/callsigns; given names are revealed through relationship (crew_bible.md).

abara.name: Abara
abara.wants: a crew that comes home; a verdict on Corvane
abara.hidden: locked box with her grandfather's fire-control module; unsure if she still believes Corvane
abara.fear: Losing someone she should have kept safe.
abara.line: Thirty years cleaning up after captains. Sit down, tea's hot. Let's find out what kind of mess you are.
abara.relationships: Dace exhausts her and quietly becomes her favorite; they argue about everything [new, fits O'Brien and Bashir]. Shares a cabin with Castellan: she's tidy, he isn't, they respect each other. Longest history with Corvane, unresolved.

dace.name: Dace
dace.wants: recognition; permission to use AI to save someone
dace.hidden: expelled over an AI-assisted treatment that worked; does not think it was wrong
dace.line: Oh, that's fascinating. Sorry, no, it's terrible. But it's also fascinating. Hold still and let me look.
dace.relationships: Abara is the person he most wants to impress [new, fits Bashir and O'Brien]. Shares a cabin with Quill, who thinks he never stops talking. Rivalry with Castellan over who's smarter.

castellan.name: Castellan
castellan.wants: to be forgiven before he confesses
castellan.hidden: built part of the reactor off the books on Corvane's orders and knows where Pell lives
castellan.fear: A reactor failing on his watch. Again.
castellan.line: She's not broke, she's sulking. Give me twenty minutes and a sandwich and she'll come around.
castellan.relationships: Has decided Quill is his friend; she hasn't objected [new, fits Tucker and Reed]. Shares a cabin with Abara: she's tidy, he isn't, they respect each other. Bar bet with Fenwick.

quill.name: Quill
quill.hidden: logged signals she cannot explain; told no one
quill.fear: A signal she can't explain, and being the only one who heard it.
quill.line: With respect, Captain, "probably" isn't a reading. Give me ten minutes and I'll have a real one.
quill.relationships: Castellan has decided they're friends; she minds less than she lets on [new, fits Reed and Tucker]. Shares a cabin with Dace, who never stops talking.

fenwick.name: Fenwick
fenwick.wants: to be seen, and to have help
fenwick.hidden: supplies off-grid survivor pockets from ship cargo
fenwick.fear: A ship that stops eating together.
fenwick.line: Sit, sit! You look like you've been living on ration bars. There's soup, there's bread, and there's something I'm calling stew until somebody tells me otherwise.
fenwick.relationships: Feeds everyone, which gives him quiet influence. Bar bet with Castellan. Quickest to forgive (the officer who doesn't really resent you on the murder route) [proposal].

pell.name: Pell
pell.fear: Unknown. It gets chatty when it's scared.
pell.line: Contact. Probably hostile. Definitely rude, arriving unannounced.
pell.relationships: Corvane treated it as a colleague, never a tool. Castellan knows where it lives. Keeps a running grudge ledger against Dace over the sink cooling (was Pike's).

corvane.name: Ilsa Corvane
corvane.line: I don't enjoy this. I'd like you to know that. I'm going to do it anyway.

_note_station: station = the room id where the walkable demo places them (design/rooms/*.json). Quill is placed in the control room; the demo currently shows Abara there with Quill unplaced.
_cards: Full card text in crew_cards.json (v2). Pairings: Abara-Dace (friends who argue), Castellan-Quill (he decided they are friends); cabins Abara+Castellan, Dace+Quill.
